objects.text: This stretch of wall is newer than the room, and somebody was paid for it not to look it.^It very nearly doesn't.| A cut will not shift it. Your whole weight might, or something thrown that does not care about walls.
shekels:40
{g}'THE CUT. THE DEAD FILLED IT WITH DARK, SO THAT NOBODY LIVING SHOULD CROSS.'{/}^{g}'NOBODY LIVING HAS.'{/}| There is a thief's sack on the far side.
A stone coffin, lid on.^From inside, the sound of fingers drumming.~~In the dream it is only a stone box.~~A stone coffin, lid on.^From inside: nothing at all. Bliss.

{g}'FOUR FIRES FOR THE FOUR WATCHES OF THE NIGHT. THEN HE WILL SEE YOU.'{/}^Under it, smaller: {g}'THE FIRES ARE KEPT IN FOUR HALLS, SO THAT NO ONE SERVANT CAN LIGHT THEM ALL AND GET IT OVER WITH.'{/}

{g}'THE KING'S SUN. IT IS CARRIED BEFORE HIM IN THE MORNING AND BEHIND HIM AT NIGHT.'{/}^{g}'IT IS NOT TO BE ROLLED.'{/}| Something has been rolling something. There is a groove in the floor a hand deep.
gong:t2_gong2
objects.say: Round the corner, off the wall, and home: the gong sings.^In front of the third fire, a grille lifts.

objects.text: {g}'THE SUN RISES IN THE EAST. IT IS ALWAYS LEAVING.'{/}^{g}'STAND ON THE SUN. THROW AT THE SUNRISE.'{/}| Somebody has added: {g}'it comes back. it is the only one that does.'{/}
{g}'THE WARDENS OF THE INNER DOOR. THEY DO NOT TURN THEIR BACKS.'{/}^{g}'THEY HAVE NEVER HAD TO.'{/}
The queen's coffin. The lid is on, and from inside there is no sound at all.^She is the one person in this tomb who is getting any rest.
{g}'THE QUEEN. SHE ASKED TO BE BURIED FURTHER AWAY.'{/}^{g}'THIS WAS AS FAR AWAY AS THE KING WOULD ALLOW.'{/}| Her lyre is in the next hall. She asked about that, too.
vessel

A post, and a rope as thick as your wrist made fast to it.^The rope goes out over the drop to the top of the drawbridge. Cut it and the bridge comes down.| It is a long way out for a blade. Not for something thrown.
{g}'THE LAST WATCH.'{/}^{g}'THE BRIDGE IS RAISED AT NIGHT.'{/}| It has been night for four hundred years.
A king's treasure, heaped where the bearers set it down.^You are the night watch. You are the one man in Ashkel who can't.
A king's treasure, heaped where the bearers set it down.^You are the night watch. You are the one man in Ashkel who can't.
{g}'THE QUEEN IS NOT IN.'{/}^Under it, smaller, in her own hand: {g}'TO THE KING, ESPECIALLY.'{/}

A couch, a lamp, and a board set up for a game for one.^She had this room walled off the week she was buried, and paid the mason twice: once to build the wall, and once to forget where.| It is the only room in the tomb that anybody chose.
A garden, in troughs and jars, under a hole in the roof the size of a plate.^Everything in it has been dead for four hundred years, except one myrtle that is doing it out of spite.
